Chapter 585: Chapter 23 Ninety Million Spatial Layers (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 585: Chapter 23 Ninety Million Spatial Layers (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Even with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, dozens of cosmic forces, more than a dozen higher cosmic forces, and one Source-level Cosmic Force aiding him,

Lin Yuan dared to set his sights only on the countless Spatial Layers, and that too was a result of spending a thousand years of residence time.

Even so, such a pace of expansion had reached ten thousand Spatial Layers a day, which in the eyes of other Ninth Rank powerhouses was utterly unattainable.

But now, with the advent of ‘Divine Lattice’, especially those with spatial attributes, it was as if he had been handed the ‘key’ that unlocked the essence of the Space Rules of this world.

Lin Yuan’s speed at expanding the Derived Space Layers soared exponentially, completely defying all logic.

To simply put it, those Ninth Stage powerhouses in the Main World Prime Universe had to comprehend and expand their Spatial Layers bit by bit, one at a time, while Lin Yuan’s method of expansion was different; he could simply use the layers of this world as a template for his own.

...

The moment he finished expanding a Spatial Layer, he would instantly grasp the spatial Origin Source insights related to that layer.

For example, the Ninth Stage powerhouses in the Main Universe had to create Spatial Layers from scratch, like deriving a complex ‘formula’ without any direction or target known in advance.

Whereas for Lin Yuan, it was as if he had already received this ‘formula’ beforehand and merely needed to derive the process from it, which drastically reduced the difficulty by several magnitudes.

“Ninety million Spatial Layers?” Lin Yuan gently closed his eyes, feeling the ‘boundless’ power transmitted from his Inner World throughout his body.

In the starry sky where the Myriad Clans of the Main World classified the Ninth Rank into five tiers, reaching ten million layers was already the extreme limit of the Ninth Stage Peak.

As for ninety million layers?

Hunyi had opened up thirty million Spatial Layers and thus was already the strongest Ninth Rank being of the Tianyu Clan. Ninety million layers, one could estimate that throughout all the races of the Main Universe and even including those unique “special beings,”

there were probably only a handful that could come close.

Here close does not mean reach or exceed.

Especially those unique special beings, which are so rare in the vast cosmos, their innate talents are terrifying beyond belief.

These special beings with such unfathomable depth could open up Spatial Layers with almost the same ease as eating or drinking drink—scarcely any less simple.

Even so, to expand to ninety million Spatial Layers… not to mention expanding, even just counting layer by layer, it would take a very long time, wouldn’t it?

The most critical point is, according to the current trend, ninety million layers is far from Lin Yuan’s limit, with still more than half of his designated residence time remaining.

Lin Yuan still had a great deal of room to grow.

“It’s a pity, the current Demigod Lattice is not of much use to me anymore,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Over the past three hundred years, he had used his two Primordial Spirits to search the world for Demigod Lattices with spatial attributes, that is, demigods with the ability to manipulate space.

If one were to divide the spatial Origin Source of this world from bottom to top into ten thousand parts,

the ‘key’ to the spatial essence held within a Demigod’s Demigod Lattice would only occupy the lower third of that range.

As for the upper two-thirds, the Demigod Lattice’s tier was too low; it could not see that far.

As Lin Yuan gradually mastered the bottom third of the spatial Origin Source, other Demigod Lattices with spatial attributes began to ‘overlap’ with the spatial essence he had already grasped.

“The Divine Lattice of a True God should be able to help me further advance,” Lin Yuan looked up at the sky, which in reality meant observing the Spatial Layers where the Ocean of Light and the dark abyss resided.

“No rush.”

“Take it slow.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts reconverged, even though the current Demigod Lattice didn’t have as great an effect on him as before,

it still had some use; he still intended to thoroughly comprehend the Demigod Lattice and the one-third area of spatial essence it could glimpse into before dealing with divine matters.

…..

“My Inner World has now reached a scale of one hundred eight three billion miles in circumference…”

Lin Yuan’s Consciousness Descent into his Inner World revealed that he had absorbed much of the sixth type of liquid from the Mysterious Gourd—the blue liquid—over the past three hundred years.

In theory, once he completely absorbed the first six types of colored liquids, Lin Yuan’s Inner World would reach a circumference of one point nine nine eight billion miles.

“Approaching two billion miles for my Inner World, plus ninety million Spatial Layers… my current power should be at the level of 9th Rank Invincible, shouldn’t it?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Unlike the Eighth Layer, the Ninth Rank did not entertain the concept of invincibility.

Because the confrontation between Ninth Rank powerhouses was not about the level of power and might; it wasn’t a matter of brute strength ensuring victory.

Unless it is a strike from a Supreme Being that tears through countless Spatial Layers, a strike of such caliber that no matter where you hide or flee to within those layers, you are doomed to die, the combat among Ninth Rank fighters requires competing across multiple Spatial Layers.

For instance, under specific conditions, Ninth Rank fighters like Xilan, who cannot open up less than a million Spatial Layers, can easily elude top Ninth Rank fighters like Hunyi who can open over thirty million Spatial Layers.

But that was before.

Now, with the scale and solid foundation of Lin Yuan’s Inner World, he could effortlessly suppress other Ninth Rank fighters with a mere gesture, including Hunyi who could open over thirty million Spatial Layers.

If this isn’t invincibility, what is?

“Now I just need to conclude my traversal, the predicament of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is truly nothing…” Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

However, doing so would be somewhat of a waste of this opportunity to traverse, even though he had the world coordinates in hand and could continue the Consciousness Descent, it would require the expenditure of ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

“Time…”

Lin Yuan, through the will of his Inner World, raised his right hand, and time began to fluctuate smoothly and steadily, either accelerating or pausing.

“Time pause?”

A touch of surprise flashed across Lin Yuan’s eyes, as in the past three hundred years, he had deduced over two hundred Time Rule Models, gaining some understanding of the ability to pause time.

“It can’t be maintained for a long duration?”

Lin Yuan tried it out and found that the longer he sustained the “time pause” state, the greater the backlash from the Time Rules would become.

It’s like when you forcefully dam up a breach; you may stop the river’s flow temporarily, but as the upstream water accumulates more and more, the eventual breach will result in an even more severe disaster.

The pause in time was similar.

Forcing time to pause in a particular region would continuously suffer backlash brought about by corrections from Time Rules.

With Lin Yuan’s current foundation, he could at most pause time in a certain region for twenty breaths. Any longer, and he would suffer irreversible damage.

And the region where time was paused couldn’t contain any exceedingly powerful life forms.

Pausing time for a stone versus pausing time for a Ninth Rank life form, naturally, they are not the same in terms of difficulty.

…

In the midst of his thoughts.

Lin Yuan looked around at the numerous clansmen of the Longshan Family, and began to impart the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill.

Several hours passed.

Lin Yuan’s lecture reached its conclusion.

Under the rapt gaze of countless Longshan Family members, Lin Yuan disappeared from the center of the arena.

…

The underground cultivation room.

Lin Yuan’s figure reappeared.

“These three hundred years, I have secretly abducted a large number of Demigods, including many from the True God Church… It must have had a significant impact,” Lin Yuan silently pondered.

To better comprehend the spatial essence of this world and thereby open up layer upon layer of space, Lin Yuan, apart from the Demigods of the Main God Church whom he did not target, had visited most of those from the True God Church.

This was far more serious than the pillaging of the ‘Divine Crystals’ from the True God Church three hundred years ago.

In the absence of interference from the True Gods, the Demigod-tier powerhouses are the strongest combat forces of the churches.

As for the descent of godly power incarnations? They are the last resort; most matters, as well as conflicts with other churches, still rely on the Demigod-tier powerhouses.

“It’s not a problem.”

Lin Yuan only pondered for a moment, not too concerned.

If three hundred years ago, Lin Yuan held some apprehension toward the gods of the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss, after all, the twenty-four Prime Gods were beings of his same rank.

Now, having opened ninety million Spatial Layers and with his Inner World approaching an expanse of nearly two hundred million square miles, Lin Yuan has truly become in this world—

Unfearing of all.
